events.title: DaVita Stock Up Following Q1 Earnings & Revenue Beat, Margins Expand
events.body: DVA's first-quarter 2026 results benefit from expanding margins and steady dialysis demand across its broad clinic network.

events.title: COR Stock Falls on Q2 Earnings & Revenue Miss, FY26 EPS View Raised
events.body: Cencora shares sink after Q2 earnings and revenues miss estimates, even as the company raises its fiscal 2026 EPS outlook.

events.title: TMDX Dips After Posting Q1 Earnings & Revenue Miss, Margins Fall
events.body: TransMedics' Q1 revenues rise 21% on strong OCS demand, but a sharp EPS miss and margin pressure send shares down despite continued logistics growth.

events.title: FMS Stock Rises Despite Q1 Earnings & Sales Miss, Margins Expand
events.body: Fresenius Medical's shares rise after Q1 earnings miss estimates as margin expansion and FME25+ savings support operating income growth.
